drum_performances.name: Louis Moholo
drum_performances.why_it_matters: His first album as leader, "a classic example of the combination of British and South African players".

tracks.title: You Ain't Gonna Know Me 'Cos You Think You Know Me

drums.description: A township-jazz tune over which Moholo plays a rolling, almost free pulse, tom-heavy and polyrhythmic, pushing the horns rather than keeping strict time.
Moholo's open, surging pulse: a fast swing that dissolves into free-time crashes and tom rolls under the London free-jazz horns.
Melodic, tom-led drumming in a South African groove that drifts in and out of free time.
